rationale: Price has bounced from the $10.87 low back to $10.94 but remains well below both the 5-min VWAP ($11.11) and session VWAP ($11.29), preserving the structural short thesis; the bounce appears to be on declining volume with no new bullish catalyst. The original invalidation at $11.05 has not been breached, and the 9-EMA ($10.91) is acting as a near-term magnet rather than support, suggesting the bounce is corrective rather than a trend reversal. No action is warranted until price either approaches the take-profit target or threatens the invalidation level.
